purpose: Make Ariadna Host / Heritage a first-class character option instead of using Career or fake faction choices as a proxy.

source.careerTables: Ariadna Supplement Dogface/Wulver and Antipode Career Tables already captured in V64 source metadata.

changes: Adds Host / Heritage with Standard / Human, Dogface, Wulver, and Antipode options for Ariadna.
Adds Current Form for Dogface: Human Form or Dog-Warrior Form.
Dogface Dog-Warrior form applies +2 Agility, +2 Brawn, +1 Vigour soak and restores the custom HP/Vigor track to full when entered.
Wulver applies AGI +1, AWA +1, BRW +1, COO -1, PER -1, WIL -1 and exposes the source +2 Vigour note.
Antipode applies AGI +2, AWA +1, BRW +2, COO -1, INT -2, PER -2, +2 Vigour soak and locks Firewall to 0.
Host modifiers change effective Main Skill totals and therefore flow to their sub-skills without overwriting the saved base Main Skill ratings.
Dogface, Wulver and Antipode no longer consume one of the three ordinary Trait slots.
Host choice filters source-compatible Careers. Dogface cannot select Wulver Shock Troop; Wulver can.
Antipode receives its source career list and tribe Homeworld/Habitat choices.
The old Ariadna - Dog-Blooded and Ariadna - Antipode UI faction choices are hidden but their source records/mappings remain for migration and reference.
Legacy saves infer Host / Heritage from old host Trait/faction selections and remove the old host Trait from ordinary Trait slots.
Host / Heritage and Current Form persist through browser save/autosave and XML, and Ariadna Host / Heritage is printed in the portfolio.
Non-Ariadna factions show Host / Heritage as not applicable in this build.

compatibility.customMainSkillRulePreserved: Main skills still cannot use Focus. Host modifiers alter effective main-skill totals; ordinary Trait/Talent automatic bonuses remain sub-skill-only.

notes: The sheet does not roll Dogface's Discipline D1 transformation check. The player/GM resolves that test, then changes Current Form; all supported form modifiers apply automatically.
Wulver's +2 Vigour is surfaced as a Host modifier because the custom sheet's HP/Vigor track remains capped at 20.

Dogface armour damage, Fatigued when the form ends, Antipode Primal Technology/Pack Mentality/Trinary Mind, and equipment tailoring remain rules text because the sheet has no dedicated subsystems for those effects.
